note: Steps-to-leaps mix step 17: the 4th and the 5th from one Do, up and down under Do over a drone, then two 5ths-stage tunes in a second key, one that fills its 5ths with steps and one with a single 4th. The tunes start at 60 (tempo is moves, up to 90); the key is not, because the staff's notes under Do only exist in keys from about F up for a tenor, so the second key is written in. missing: 5ths-stage tunes rated Hard (an intermediate singer gets two Expert ones), and a way for moves to keep a block to the keys where notes under Do fit.

exercise.title: 4ths and 5ths, side by side
exercise.why: From Do a 4th lands on Fa and a 5th on Sol, one step apart, so singing the two leaps side by side and filling them with steps teaches your ear which one a tune asks for.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. From the low {{1}}, leap up to {{4}} and back, then up to {{5}} and back. Sing it on "ah".
Then go under {{1}}: leap down to the {{5}} under it, a 4th, and down to the {{4}} under it, a 5th.
Practice until you know which leap is coming before you sing it.

Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. It leaps a 5th from Do up to Sol and steps down, then does the same from Re up to La. At the end it drops a 5th, from Re to the Sol under Do, and comes home through the Ti under Do. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once the drop under Do lands without a slide, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.

This tune is in a new key and starts on the Sol under Do. Its leaps are all 5ths but one: near the end it leaps a 4th, from Re up to Sol. Tap its first note below to hear it. Then press Play below to hear the tune: the mic starts with it. Listen once, then sing along on "la".
If the 4th lands too high, sing Re, Fa, Sol slowly, then put the leap back in the tune.
When the key changes, Do moves and the leaps are still 5ths and one 4th.
